question: What is Value at Risk (VaR)? Explain its features, uses and limitations.

points.label: Meaning
points.description: The maximum expected loss on a portfolio over a given time horizon at a given confidence level, under normal market conditions.

points.label: Features
points.description: It depends on the time horizon, the confidence level and the distribution or volatility of returns.

points.label: Uses
points.description: Used to measure risk, set risk limits, allocate capital and report risk to management and regulators.

points.label: Limitations
points.description: It assumes normal markets, does not show the size of losses beyond the confidence level, and depends on historical data and model assumptions.
